summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Il Pescematto after migrating admin auth to FastAPI JWT + bcrypt and moving phone/menu to MongoDB. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (login 200 + wrong-cred 401, GET /api/settings/phone|menu public, PUT/DELETE phone|menu enforced by Bearer JWT, Create->GET persistence verified). Frontend: cookie notice ack persists (cookie_notice.acknowledged in localStorage), Home loads phone from /api/settings/phone (not from bundle), admin login stores JWT under key 'auth.token' in localStorage (AsyncStorage web backend), redirect to /admin/settings after login, JWT persisted across full page reload, admin phone edit PUTs to backend and /api/settings/phone reflects the new value, admin menu editor opens, reset menu triggers DELETE /api/settings/menu (menu becomes null), logout clears 'auth.token' and re-accessing /admin/settings redirects to /admin/login. No red-screen. Only prior benign RN-Web warning ('props.pointerEvents deprecated') persists (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing RN Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; migrate remaining usages to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional: replace remaining `pointerEvents` props with `style.pointerEvents` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly uses os.environ['...'] with fail-fast on missing env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH).
JWT expiry set to 12h and returned as expires_in seconds (43200), matching the spec.
PUT /settings/phone and PUT/DELETE /settings/menu correctly require Bearer JWT via HTTPBearer(auto_error=True). Missing/invalid token yields 401/403 as expected.
settings_col uses string _id ('phone', 'menu') and responses project it out — no ObjectId leakage.
Frontend api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only; token key 'auth.token' matches request spec. AsyncStorage web shim writes to localStorage — confirmed at runtime.
useMenu/useSettings correctly fall back to bundled defaults on network error and auto-logout on 401 from mutations (forceLogout).
seed_data_creation: Tests write a marker phone value and a marker TEST_ menu payload via authenticated PUT; DELETE test resets the menu doc. No permanent seed left behind (menu doc is deleted at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pescematto_api.py (12 tests, ~2s). Public URL: https://il-pescematto.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (PESCEMATTO / MRPescematto.2026). JWT persists in localStorage['auth.token'] on web via AsyncStorage; cookie ack in localStorage['cookie_notice.acknowledged'].
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Migration to backend-side settings is fully working end-to-end.
